notes: Phase 59: Add pdf_download crawl_type support to the ingest pipeline. 4 SME-requested PDF sources (ESMF Fortran API ref, ESMC C API ref, NUOPC ref, ESMPy) contain critical coupling framework documentation with no HTML equivalent. Pipeline: download PDF → extract text via pypdf → chunk (512 tokens, 64 overlap) → embed with Titan → index to mdc-workflow-docs-titan1024. Depends on Phase 58 completing first to validate the ingest pipeline is healthy.

followUps: If text extraction quality is poor for any PDF (e.g. scanned images, heavy math), consider using Amazon Textract as an alternative extraction method.
Future PDF sources can be added to the manifest with crawl_type: pdf_download and they will be picked up automatically by the new script.
Consider adding a --refresh flag to re-download and re-ingest PDFs when upstream releases new versions (ESMF releases ~annually).
